representative_posts.text: it's not enough to abstain from using so-called "AI"; consent has never and will never mean anything to technofascists. AI is the "Grey Goo" scenario for culture; we—people who need human connection—will starve first. AI needs to be poisoned: shieldfont.org

representative_posts.text: My attitude toward AI is that it can drive HUMAN innovation and serve as an assistant in HUMAN endeavors, such as medicine and problem-solving. representative_posts.text: You will never convince the AI fans that they are part of the problem. "Oh, it's just a tool init?". Yes, a tool of destruction. Business.name: Airbnb Changes

perspectives.title: Airbnb Cleaning Fees
perspectives.summary: Airbnb's cleaning fees and guest expectations are unreasonable

representative_posts.author: jljones0618.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This kind of nonsense is why I would never stay in an AirBNB. I stick to overpriced hotels for many reasons not least of which is never having to deal with amateur hoteliers and their arbitrary cleaning fees.

representative_posts.author: williameasley.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Airbnb jumped the shark at the point where expecting the guest to clean got combined with having a cleaning fee. Both is just rent seeking

representative_posts.author: petercmoore.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Are you missing the point that Airbnb charges a cleaning fee to cover the costs of cleaning once the guests leave?

representative_posts.author: bearlypolitics.co.uk
representative_posts.text: In the past 10 years we’ve only stayed in an Airbnb about three times - it was after the third time when we were not only charged a £40 cleaning fee for a one night stay, but then also expected to wash the floors, at which point I said “fuck this for a game of soldiers.” Still not using them.

representative_posts.author: asterianbeauty.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I stopped renting from Airbnb because I can go to a hotel, not have to do any chores when I have a flight to catch or a long drive ahead of me, AND I get a free breakfast. I’m not a messy guest. Trash goes in bins. Towels are gathered for washing. So on and so forth. That’s normal in hospitality.

representative_posts.author: laurahelmuth.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Listen, the people you help when you start a load of towels or the dishwasher on your way out are not the Airbnb owners. They're the people hired to clean the place, who are paid poorly and irregularly. Some requests are ridiculous, yes, but some are about considering a cleaner's time. Tip well.

representative_posts.author: xrefugee23.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Many hotels have kitchens. A couple I’ve stayed at recently had a full one. So I really don’t see the point of an Airbnb. They take your credit card and if you left a crazy mess behind they charge you. Not hard. I’m not paying a cleaning fee then having to do a full clean.

representative_posts.author: chris-foreverf.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’m afraid you are totally wrong on this . Airbnb charge a “service fee” which is AIRBNB ‘s booking commission… it has absolutely nothing to do with cleaning but the host .

representative_posts.author: 22pcirish.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Used Airbnb in the past and there's absolutely no way I'd leave the place without it being clean and tidied. (And I'll be using the app when I come to Canada in 2028 so judge me then!)

representative_posts.author: georgeous.one
representative_posts.text: As an Airbnb host who isn't a cunt, the cost of cleaning is factored into your daily rate. As long as you don't leave shit all over the floor and don't break anything, enjoy yourselves. One family did leave a bag of dirty nappies, which I did think was not on.

representative_posts.author: onbradstreetfarm.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I love the people who insist they have to rent from AirBnB because they have children or a group, as if people haven’t been staying in hotels and motels with both forever. I would never leave a room trashed but I’m also not taking out the trash or doing the towels. Hotels/motels forever.

representative_posts.author: clareobrien.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So, Airbnb have changed what we hosts can ask tourists to do when they leave our self-catering property. Including "guests shouldn’t be asked to wash and put away dishes, but you can ask them to put used dishes in the sink." WHAT THE ACTUAL FUCK?

representative_posts.author: galaxyfarrahway.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Airbnb is so expensive now its even more than hotels

representative_posts.author: professorkiosk.wtf
representative_posts.text: my husband and I stayed at an airbnb with a 10 page (front and back) binder full of rules, most of which were cleaning. I didn't mind a lot of it but they wanted us to make the fucking bed as well before we left and I was like, wtf are we paying a cleaning fee for anyway?? we didn't make the bed

representative_posts.author: dcmcollectibles.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: AirBnB, the cause of unaffordable rent/purchase housing

representative_posts.author: slimwasherman.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I've stayed in many Airbnb properties. The costs, in whatever form they came, were clear. As were the duties upon leaving the property. I have owned an Airbnb property, we made the costs and the duties upon leaving clear. Nothing hidden, either way. I'm not sure what the fuss is all about.

representative_posts.author: stuartbayens.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Airbnb has revised its rules to reduce the tasks a host can expect a guest to perform at the end of their stay — and washing dishes has been wiped from the to-do list. Airbnb has advised hosts to choose from seven standard house rules that will be displayed prominently on the listing page.

representative_posts.author: penguinfury.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I wonder (hope?) if this will make AirBnB’s just slightly less profitable enough for corporations to stop doing this.

representative_posts.author: kellydf.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Nowadays I just book hotel rooms instead because of what a nightmare AirBnB has become in the ensuing years. Maybe this rule change will bring back some of the old magic, who knows

representative_posts.author: slimwasherman.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If I show up at someone's Airbnb, is it now expected that I can use all their cutlery for a week and leave it all in an unwashed pile at the end of my stay? That's bollocks.

representative_posts.author: dashwallkick.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This happening the same week of Airbnb telling its posts that they can't make clients do chores is extremely apt. "you're not allowed to not like my product or business, you have to kiss it on the mouth and say you love it, someone arrest them for not loving me and my profitable business"

representative_posts.author: asterianbeauty.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: All of this Airbnb discourse is genuinely funny to me. Hosts are crashing out because they’re being expected to do a hospitality job that they signed up for. The disconnect was beautifully described as: They’re realizing they’re in hospitality after thinking they were in the renting business.

representative_posts.author: deejayalex.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Payment should include this already. Hotels do it daily... I will never support AirBnB

representative_posts.author: ausnewstoday.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Airbnb's ban on check-out chores starts 20 November. Some hosts plan to close bookings that day in protest from 20 November, an Airbnb host can't ask you to do a check-out chore list on top of the cleaning fee. #auspol

representative_posts.author: refrag.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Oh, so this is why people were talking about Airbnb yesterday It's been a while since I Airbnb-ed. (Last trip, just last weekend, we properly B&B-ed, if you get me.) I don't remember this being a thing on those trips, or if it was, that it was at all onerous, beyond "ffs don't be a slob"

representative_posts.author: biohazardzero.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 50% of rents on the island of Montreal are converted to airbnbs. people cant live anywhere. they absolutely deserve this.

representative_posts.author: tree-05.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Also, having worked for several Airbnb owners, they only think about the gravy train of easy money

representative_posts.author: xrefugee23.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Exactly. Basic cleanliness (no garbage on floor etc) just like how you should leave a hotel room is sufficient. If you don’t want to hire a cleaner or clean yourself then don’t rent out. Hotels take your credit card and charge if you were gross or damaged stuff.

representative_posts.author: dalishbandit.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If the co-founder of a game company is saying that studios should use genAI in production and simultaneously saying they didn’t feel pressure to use it that’s enough for me to write them off.

representative_posts.author: ohheyitsallison.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This is infuriating. GenAI is a plague.

representative_posts.author: phoenixultima.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Even in the best-case scenario where someone using AI has a new, bold idea, they're still using a tool fed on the work of others that guzzles our water and power and smokes the sky, just to rearrange all that stolen work into a different shape. GenAI is fundamentally immoral.

representative_posts.author: scalawagjack.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Read this thread. It perfectly sums up the nefarious danger GenAI is to our day to day humanity. As Sir Terry Pratchett noted, humans need storytelling to be human and all human creation is ultimately is storytelling. When you outsource creativity to a machine you surrender a piece of your humanity.

representative_posts.author: ratheronfire.com
representative_posts.text: Just for the record all the code in this project is human-made. I'm strongly opposed to the use of genAI for software development (and also for any other purpose). If you're curious you can see my code over here:

representative_posts.author: vimesofthewatch.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: That's a big part of why I despise genAI. It taking over all conversations about machine learning tech even though it is just one very shitty application of something with otherwise potentially very useful applications is another.

representative_posts.author: spider.florist
representative_posts.text: So yeah idk I get the surface level “well I’ll boycott a game that uses it for art but not code”. But if you draw a line that includes some uses of genai but not others then sooner or later, one way or another, you’re gonna be moving that line.

representative_posts.author: sarsion.net
representative_posts.text: jesus it really is just about money to these guys. like, breaking even to make your “dream game” is GOOD. it means you got to spend that time doing that you loved and lived on it. what the hell. if they really think using genAI to make games is the solution they think it is, WHY DON’T WE WANT IT?

representative_posts.text: via Jank’s Sunday round up, this is a pretty complete rebuttal to most of the genAI nonsense I’m exposed to every bloody day at the moment. Watching a home computer site tear itself apart rn for, like, two or three insistent posters is painful when this is so easy.

representative_posts.author: smileburger.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: With regards to the Blood Of The Dawnwalker controversy, I just want to point out that TTS ≠ GenAI I understand being hesitant, or upset, but I really don’t think this is on the same level as using GenAI.

representative_posts.author: fishwithlasers.bsky.social

representative_posts.text: I find this moving in art & culture circles generally. People who are generally quite switched on simply have no idea that games-as-art is even a thing, and think of games solely as something their kids do. They're intimidated by controllers, and lack gaming literacy to get started.

Culture.name: Media Bias

perspectives.title: Journalists Journalism
perspectives.summary: Journalists are criticized for their methods

representative_posts.author: enbuenora.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: There are loads of fantastic journalists, and you see this frequently when big investigations land. The problem is who owns & manages each company (including whatever networks they are a part of). That controls what is routinely published, the emphasis, the spin, and the regular sources.

representative_posts.author: sometimespdx.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think good journalists use lots of sources for their research and for coming up with good articles. Anonymous sources have their place but journalists should verify what is being said. That's why I rely heavily on video clips and screenshots. It's best if you hear it from the source.

representative_posts.author: getthebrief.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Community journalists reporting at local and provincial levels bear the brunt of these attacks. They lack institutional protection and legal backing that network reporters have. Most cases never reach national news.

representative_posts.author: kevinharvey.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Something the vast majority of journalists are totally unaware of. Profound ignorance.

representative_posts.author: cliff229.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I can't understand why journalists don't respond to trump's lies and general attacks on their peers. When he calls individuals piggy, or stupid, or fake, why don't others in the scrum respond in kind? What is wrong with these people! If an unbiased media doesn't exist, neither does a democracy.

representative_posts.author: getthebrief.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: When local journalists are silenced, communities lose their eyes and ears on what's actually happening on the ground. That's where power operates without scrutiny.

representative_posts.author: jimallthetime.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: '... there is a fundamental difference between attacking a newspaper’s reporting and attempting to use the police and threats of litigation against journalists whose investigations have found you out to be a bit fucking dodgy'

representative_posts.author: jeffjl54.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Oh FFS. It is like Charlie Brown and the football. When will journalists treat this administration like the Bad Faith actors they are.

representative_posts.author: thecreamfacedloon.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Used to be people trusted microblogging sites because they raised the voices of live witnesses and first hand observers. Once bad actors realised that lazy journalists would recycle anything trending in pursuit of a ‘first’, the trust system collapsed. Collateral Damage: Death of Journalism.

representative_posts.author: maddness.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Again, by a woman. And again, every “journalist” should follow-up with same question and/or support fellow reporter. Men really suck at this journalism, 4th estate business.

representative_posts.author: qsy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think journalists should be able to punch CEOs in the face when they blatantly lie.

representative_posts.author: tamarasclan.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I hate the Times and will never read or support them again. Their bias isn’t journalism. It’s why we have this monster. They went after Hillary, The Obama’s and Biden’s without cause to throw chum. Trump is a pedophile raping, grifting mobster who wants to destroy America. Crickets.

perspectives.summary: People offer condolences for a loss

representative_posts.author: strangerrangers.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm so very sorry, what a terrible loss. My deepest sympathies to you and yours.

representative_posts.author: theakitaneruone.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I want to say.. thank you to all of you for your condolences. I have been taking time to care for myself (since that's really the only thing I can do), and I've been feeling a bit better. I've realized that, even when it feels hopeless, holding onto hope is the best thing you can do.

representative_posts.author: aliyahsans.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm sorry for you loss.

representative_posts.author: pupalakai.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Sincerest condolences for your loss :(

representative_posts.text: So sorry to hear this. He will be missed. 💔 Deepest condolences to his family and friends.

representative_posts.author: nangel1013.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Deepest condolences for your loss! 🙏

representative_posts.author: lindaholmes.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Many thanks to everybody who has been really lovely to me over the last week. Pet loss is for-real deep grief, and I have been a mess, but I have been really lucky too.

representative_posts.author: mowsyling.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This truly feels like grieving a personal loss.. Didn't expect it to hit so hard.. And the worst is it is so unnecessary This didn't have to happen..

representative_posts.author: jmcardinalsfan.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: bobyost.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Deeply, deeply sorry. 😔😪 I felt welcomed by Jennifer from the very start of my Bluesky account. Her faith and her caring for family and for others were very much elements in all of her posts...no matter what the topic. God bless you in this time of great loss.

representative_posts.author: thepeterkelly.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Hugs. There aren't words for this sort of loss. More hugs.

representative_posts.author: burntroze.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: menfneb.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The Cheesecake Factory is still in business?

representative_posts.author: lawless523.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 99.9% of the US would not consider the Cheesecake Factory to be high class dining. Come on.

representative_posts.text: My only Cheesecake Factory take is that their commitment to scratch cooking (literally everything is made from raw ingredients inside the restaurant, no offsite prep or pre-packaging) is cool.

representative_posts.text: look I'm not going to say anything bad about cheesecake factory, it's fine even tho people in orange county love it a weirdly disproportional amount, it's just not where I would want to base the seat of executive power

representative_posts.author: tamethestallion.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Do you disavow the cheesecake factory?

representative_posts.author: cmonmaque.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think people taking aim at how cheesecake factory is for the .1 percent are out their minds

representative_posts.text: yeah like it's kind of comically classist to think the average american genuinely believes the cheesecake factory is the height of taste and opulence

representative_posts.author: downchasm.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I've never eaten anywhere called "Cheesecake Factory" and never will – stupid name the Old Spaghetti Factory will never see my patronage either

representative_posts.author: pppgrifter.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: processanalyzer.bsky.social

representative_posts.text: To paraphrase John Mulaney, The Cheesecake Factory is a hobo’s idea of a fancy restaurant.

representative_posts.author: sarcasmodemiami.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: giggle-angel.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: snufkinlib.bsky.social

arguments: Trans women deserve respect and kindness
Being trans is a valid and important part of one's identity
Trans individuals have diverse experiences and perspectives
Respecting trans people's identities and pronouns is important
perspectives.brief: Trans people deserve respect. most people have unknowingly shared a bathroom with a trans woman. recognizing and accepting trans individuals is important. trans visibility sparks conversations.
perspectives.detail:
Trans Respect argues that Trans people deserve respect. most people have unknowingly shared a bathroom with a trans woman. recognizing and accepting trans individuals is important. trans visibility sparks conversations.

The posts defend it in their own words. @joceua.bsky.social writes, “My gender is so ambiguous at work someone thought i was a transman” @bathyspherehat.bsky.social writes, “You have to be wonderful to trans men.” @boobayaga.bsky.social writes, “Everyone is trans of course, including my Femsheps X3 Its especially fun in Warframe cause my Operator is a just out of the closet short haired androgynous twink who just started HRT and still has a masculine voice, then she meets my fully trans'd Drifter and is like "Oh 😳…”

Inside Trans Respect, the posts are arguing one position rather than a stack of unrelated claims.
